published_spontaneous_white_mutation_spe.source: Wessinger & Rausher 2012 synthesis of Streisfeld & Rausher

working_model: broad mutation supply -> tissue/pathway architecture -> pleiotropic burden -> ecological performance -> persistence/frequency/fixation
within_species_support: Ipomoea purpurea W versus A loci
cross_species_support: Del Valle et al. Table S1 PAL versus WAL frequency-scale separation
temperature_role: context-dependent ecological/physiological filter interacting with pigment architecture, not universal cause
hard_nonclaims: does not estimate mutation rates directly
does not establish an unbiased global fixation odds ratio
does not imply all white flowers have low pleiotropy
does not establish evolutionary direction of the FCP white/nonwhite axis
